The '''Skeletal Tail''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found from:
* [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]].
* [[Hoes|tilling]] soil in [[The Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]].
* From [[Mining#Bone Node|Bone Nodes]] on the [[Ginger Island]] Dig Site.
* Gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. 

Donating this item, along with the [[Prehistoric Tibia]], will reward the player with the [[Sloth Skeleton|Sloth Skeleton R]] statue.

==Bone Mill==
The Skeletal Tail can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]].

==Bundles==
Skeletal Tail is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Skeletal Tail is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Skeletal Tail is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt014|link=Tailoring{{!}}Skeleton Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a white dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe.
